NIHR502533 cohort B

Source: R/RcppExports.R
WH_NIHR502533b.Rd

Sample size simulator for NIHR502533 cohort B.

Usage

WH_NIHR502533b(
  name = "scenario 1",
  n_target = 19,
  p_nullclear = 0.1,
  p_arm0clear = 0.35,
  t_surv = 12,
  p_LTFU = 0.15,
  t_LTFU = 60,
  recrate = 7.5,
  t_recmax = 60,
  t_add = 36,
  t_max = 72,
  reps = 100000L,
  seed = 24601L
)

Arguments

name

Scenario label. Default = "scenario 1".

n_target

Target sample size. Default = 19.

p_nullclear

Null hypothesis probability of clearance at t_surv months. Default = 0.1.

p_arm0clear

Expected probability of clearance under the alternative at t_surv months. Default = 0.35.

t_surv

Time in months when clearance is assessed. Default = 12.

p_LTFU

Average proportion lost to follow-up per t_LTFU months. Default = 0.15.

t_LTFU

Duration in months over which p_LTFU are lost to follow-up. Default = 60.

recrate

Average number of participants recruited per month. Default = 7.5.

t_recmax

Maximum recruitment duration in months. Default = 60.

t_add

Months of additional follow-up after recruitment closes. Default = 36.

t_max

Maximum trial duration in months. Default = 72.

reps

Number of simulation replicates. Default = 1e5.

seed

Random seed. Default = 24601.

Value

A numeric vector with 3 elements: mean sample size, power, and mean trial duration in months.
